# s368 — Relay board lane and step lines drop cells from the right, whole

**Findings:** s356 relay 2026-10-18: lane headers and step lines (`_fit`, tui.py) still skip a cell that does not fit and keep later ones, against docs/tui.md's "drops cells from the right, whole" · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** the ended line (s356), colors, or the queue pane.

## Why

s356 gave `_place` an `ordered` flag and used it for the ended line only. Lane headers and step lines still go through `_fit` without it, so a narrow board can show a later, shorter cell beside a dropped earlier one. docs/tui.md states the drop-from-the-right rule for every board line.
